adapter_written_members: Two derived authority metadata files each within original1MiB entry authority domain
One small four-source commitment/result; original4x8MiB sources are read here and retained only by original controller, not duplicated in wrapper metadata
clock: Original startup120s includes gate/source/profile/bundle capture and first parent authority admission; work and outer walls remain root-selected independent original values, no fresh allowance. Native phase cutoffs retain min(original work end, per-phase selected budget).

gate_read_derivation.enforcement: Actual pinned gate per-call caps, declared source-total limit and sequential exception stop; not included in entry.IO counter. One oversized/changed file terminates traversal. No automatic retries.

original_outer_report: Full1320 CLI/phase metadata remains in original controller/observer retained partitions; re-read under separate qualified receipt_read_bytes; not8MiB wrapper retention.

paper_traffic.additional: numerical source/arrays/model aliases/CLI base64/source/output/journal metadata/native container input reads remain in original selected profiles. Host write accounting also charges allocation overhead. Author/ABI source bodies are cached by original controller, so only retirement is counted here as managed body read.

physical_limits: Only source-derived managed caps and future independently qualified profiles; no runtime/memory/throughput/whole-host guarantee. Central RLIMIT_AS is a per-process ceiling inherited by the unchanged controller, not aggregateRSS. External final process/resource admission remains required.
pre_final_snapshot_limit: Original inner/outer snapshots precede their own final receipt save; do not relabel them complete kernel/resource measurement.

profile.combined_managed_read_ceiling: original controller.read_bytes +outer.read_bytes +256MiB adapter IO +128MiB gate +qualified receipt_read_bytes; cumulative, never refunded
profile.combined_retention: controller.retained_bytes +outer.retained_bytes +8MiB adapter +standing OTHER; exact cross-role OTHER required
profile.full_receipt: metadata_cap_bytes is explicit complete1320-receipt capacity; receipt_read_bytes >=5*(cap+1)+4*(8MiB+1), separate from8MiB adapter retention
profile.host_memory: future qualified per-process RLIMIT_AS, inherited by unchanged controller; no total RSS/working-set/physical-capacity inference
profile.native: original exact phase/profile/model limits unchanged; full host/child site/environment/capacity still require qualification

receipt_reads: OUTER,DISPATCH,derived selection,COLLECTION,COMMITMENT each <=metadata_cap_bytes plus all4 committed programme bodies <=8MiB each: at least5*(cap+1)+4*(8388608+1). No numeric/model artifacts reopened.
